description: Questionnaire answers from the client portal, by lead_id or matter_id. format: text gives labelled plain answers. Social Security numbers and dates of birth are withheld. Sign-in required.

format.description: text: labelled answers with blanks omitted. json: structured answers. Defaults to json.

lead_id.description: Lead (intake-board task) id from list_recent_leads or find_matter. Alternative to matter_id.

matter_id.description: Matter identifier from find_matter or list_open_matters. Alternative to lead_id.

name: get_questionnaire_submission
title: Get questionnaire answers
